records.name: 1925 Care Hotline (安心專線)
records.what: The Ministry of Health and Welfare's suicide prevention line, open 24 hours a day and free to call.

records.name: Council of Indigenous Peoples (原住民族委員會)
records.what: The central government's council for Indigenous peoples, one of the ways Taiwan's 16 recognized Indigenous peoples are represented in government.
records.start: Visit the council's website for its programs and offices.
